title: Babel-17
author: Samuel R. Delany
summary: Rydra Wong, a poet and starship captain, is asked to decode Babel-17, an enemy language during an interstellar war. She finds that the language shapes the thinking of anyone who learns it.
readIf: you enjoy short, inventive science fiction about language and how it shapes the mind.
skipIf: you want hard technical science fiction or plain, linear storytelling.
